scene_spec.scene_type: visitor badge on a plain desk
scene_spec.object: A rectangular visitor badge with a white background, a blue border, and a prominent 'VISITOR' label in the center. It also has a small, generic logo at the top and 'Guest Pass' printed at the bottom. The badge is attached to a simple black lanyard.
scene_spec.location: The full badge and part of the lanyard are lying flat on a light-colored wooden desk, with the 'VISITOR' label unobstructed and clearly visible.
